backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the IoT waste management backend, implementing user profile management, bin state tracking, alert handling, and collection logging with role-based access control via AccessControl and MixinAuthorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the browser tab title and app name labels across the application consistently display 'IoT Based Smart Waste Management System', with high confidence based on DashboardLayout.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key contents of pages, layouts, and the main App entry point.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, sidebar, chart colors, etc.) used throughout the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app with the browser tab title set to 'IoT Based Smart Waste Management System' and a root div that loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (landing, login, and dashboard child routes) and wraps the app with ThemeProvider, AuthProvider, BinProvider, ToastProvider, and a global ToastContainer.
frontend/src/components/BinCard.tsx: Reusable card component that displays a single bin's fill level via CircularProgress, status badge, location, last-updated time, and online/offline indicator with color-coded borders based on fill percentage.
frontend/src/components/CircularProgress: SVG-based circular progress indicator that renders a color-coded arc (green/yellow/red) with a centered percentage label, animating fill transitions based on the provided percentage prop.
frontend/src/components/SecurityCard.tsx: Presentational card component for the Settings page that displays a security feature with an icon, title, description, and an animated 'Active Protection' status indicator.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Button component that toggles between dark and light themes using the ThemeContext, displaying a Sun or Moon icon depending on the current theme.
frontend/src/components/ToastContainer.t: Fixed-position toast notification container that renders active toasts from ToastContext with type-specific icons, colors, and a dismiss button for warning, error, success, and info types.
frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: React context providing authentication state (isAuthenticated, userEmail) with login/logout functions that persist state to localStorage under a fixed key.
frontend/src/contexts/BinContext.tsx: Provides a React context managing smart bin data, including simulated fill level updates every 4 seconds, alert generation when bins exceed 80% capacity, and a dispatch function to log and reset bin collections.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: Provides a React context for toggling between dark and light themes, persisting the preference to localStorage and applying the appropriate CSS class to the document root.
frontend/src/contexts/ToastContext.tsx: Provides a React context for displaying transient toast notifications with support for info, warning, error, and success types, auto-removing them after 5 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the current Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnimatedCounter.ts: Custom hook that animates a numeric counter from 0 to a target value over a specified duration using requestAnimationFrame with an ease-out cubic curve.
frontend/src/hooks/useHistoricalData.ts: Custom hook that tracks and stores a rolling history of bin fill levels over time, pre-populating with 10 initial data points and appending new entries whenever bin levels change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, identity persistence, and delegation validity checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes using OKLCH color tokens, glassmorphism utility classes, and typography setup with Inter and Space Grotesk fonts via Tailwind.
frontend/src/layouts/DashboardLayout.tsx: Defines the main dashboard shell with a collapsible sidebar navigation, active alert badge, theme toggle, user info display, and logout functionality using React Router.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider contexts.
frontend/src/pages/Alerts.tsx: Alerts page displaying active and resolved bin fill-level alerts, with toast notifications for new alerts and a dispatch button to send collection trucks.
frontend/src/pages/Analytics.tsx: Analytics page showing waste data visualizations including line, bar, and pie charts using Recharts, with summary stat cards derived from bin context and historical data.
frontend/src/pages/BinMonitoring.tsx: Bin monitoring page displaying real-time fill levels for all smart bins in a grid with status summary counts, a critical alert banner, and a color legend.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardOverview.tsx: Dashboard overview page showing animated stat cards for total bins, active alerts, waste collected, and network health, pulling data from the BinContext.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page with a parallax hero section, global waste statistics, system architecture steps, and feature highlights, with navigation to the login page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the admin login page with email/password form validation, mock authentication via AuthContext, and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/MapView.tsx: Displays an interactive map with positioned bin markers color-coded by fill level, and shows a detail popup with bin status, fill level, and last-seen time when a marker is clicked.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Shows a collection log table with summary stats (total collections, today's count, average fill at dispatch, unique bins) and supports CSV export of the collection history.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Renders the settings page with account info, a theme toggle, notification preferences, and a read-only security overview listing encryption, API, RBAC, and cloud protection features.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (including from hash-based routes), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom fonts (Inter, Space Grotesk), oklch-based color tokens for UI components, and smart city color palettes (blue, green, yellow, red). Enables dark mode via class, and includes typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 5) for an IoT-based Smart Waste Management SaaS app built with React/Vite/Tailwind, documenting architectural notes, known issues, and a detailed list of existing implemented features.
